نغرندي (form IIIq)
# نَغْرَنْدِي (naḡrandī) /naɣ.ran.diː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِغْرَنْدَى (iḡrandā)
# نَغْرَنْدِيَ (naḡrandiya) /naɣ.ran.di.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِغْرَنْدَى (iḡrandā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
